rule: group accounts by gated repo pulled within W=3600s (NO origin field); PAGE if size>=5, distinct>=4, partition P<1.6, FRESH>=0.8 (fraction of cohort created in-window), DECLARED<=0.2 (fraction using org-scoped access). Non-artefact separators only (UA and 13s cadence excluded).
note: Not pre-registered (built after seeing dev swarm); this is an out-of-sample check on the same held-out seeds used for H7.

held_out_swarm_103_112.fresh_separation: swarm cohorts fresh=0.91-1.00; cleared honest/approved-lab cohorts fresh=0.00

complementarity_vs_h7: H7 caught 78/86 accounts (incl. non-pulling orchestrator via co-registration, needs shared origin); origin-independent caught 69 (pullers only, survives origin rotation). Union covers more; intended as two planes of the same v2.
limits: Flags only accounts that actually pulled shards; a non-pulling orchestrator needs the co-registration plane (H7).
FRESH is defeated by pre-aged accounts (identity-marketplace cost -> pushes toward account-creation friction).
Still assumes the swarm partitions; an overlap-to-evade swarm (high P) is not caught by the partition plane (but pays a quota cost).
